five_hard_laws.name: Absolute Sovereignty
five_hard_laws.description: Every agent must operate under localized civil and cultural guidelines of its host physical region.

five_hard_laws.name: Containment Dominance
five_hard_laws.description: No critical system actuation can proceed without human-in-the-loop acknowledgement (human_approved == 1).

five_hard_laws.name: Mathematical Confidence Bounds
five_hard_laws.description: Any automated operations require objective reasoning confidence of at least 0.65.

five_hard_laws.name: Forensic Immutability
five_hard_laws.description: All transactions must be error-corrected via Reed-Solomon and logged permanently on a local index.

five_hard_laws.name: P2P Epistemic Consensus
five_hard_laws.description: Sovereign nodes must dynamically discover each other via mDNS and vote to resolve semantic conflicts.
